dos.text: Use <moz-button type="split"> for new code, it's the modern, actively-maintained implementation; the classic <button type="menu"> still ships and works but is the older pattern.
Always pair the classic type="menu" with a real <menupopup> child, open()/hasMenu() depend on one actually being present.

donts.text: Don't cite toolbarbutton.js as a split-button implementation, it has no menu-button/split rendering branch at all, only plain icon+label and a badged icon+label.
Don't expect the classic dropmarker fragment to render for type="checkbox" or type="radio", those are unrelated modes of the same MozButtonBase class, not split-button variants.
